status_summary: Executive Order 14185 (signed 2025-01-27, published 2025-02-03 at 90 FR 8763) directed DOD to abolish DEI offices, bar promotion of listed concepts including divisive concepts and gender ideology in DOD education, and review service academy leadership, curriculum and instructors. A Secretary of Defense memo of 2025-01-29, known here through press reports because the PDF could not be opened, ended race- and sex-based goals for promotion, hiring and academy admissions, ended DEI councils and working groups, barred teaching of critical race theory, DEI and gender ideology, and set up a task force. GAO reported on 2025-04-17 that DOD abolished or restructured all 41 remaining civilian and military positions with primary DEI duties. AP reported on 2025-04-01 that the Naval Academy removed nearly 400 library books in the DEI review and that the Naval Academy, West Point and Air Force Academy had completed curriculum reviews, but no results were published. On the tenure item, an undated Department of War release announcing a Secretary of War memo (dated 2026-09-29 per AP and the memo header) says the Military Departments were told to stop, effective immediately, appointing civilian faculty members to tenured posts at the service academies, and AP reports that existing tenure is kept; the Mandate calls for eliminating tenure and applying contractor rules to instructors, and no change to instructor status was found.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14185, Restoring America's Fighting Force (signed 2025-01-27, published 2025-02-03 at 90 FR 8763), directs the Secretaries of Defense and Homeland Security (for the Coast Guard) to abolish DEI offices and their vestiges, bars the Department and its educational institutions from promoting divisive concepts, gender ideology and related claims, and orders a review of the leadership, curriculum and instructors of the service academies. Implementation guidance is due in 30 days and a progress report in 180 days.

Secretary of Defense memo (same title) ends race- and sex-based preferences and DEI advisory boards and working groups and sets up a task force, with an initial report due 2025-03-01 and a final report due 2025-06-01; reporting says academies must end race- and sex-based admissions goals and may not teach critical race theory, DEI, or gender ideology (the memo PDF returned an access error, so its text was not read).

AP reports the Naval Academy removed nearly 400 books from its library as part of the DEI review, and that the Naval Academy, West Point and the Air Force Academy had completed required curriculum reviews; a full list of removed books had not been released.
GAO reports DOD abolished or restructured all 41 remaining civilian and military positions with primary DEI duties after the January 2025 orders.

The Department of War announces a directive signed by the Secretary telling the Military Departments to stop, effective immediately, appointing civilian faculty members to tenured posts at the service academies (memo titled Refocusing the Military Service Academies on Warfighter Education; date per AP and the memo header, as the release is undated); AP reports that faculty already tenured keep their status.

title: Abolish DOD diversity offices and end DEI and critical race theory training
uncertainties: The Department of War release was read from a copy supplied to the project; it could not be opened directly in the research pass or by the independent reviewer. The release shows no date, so 2026-09-29 comes from the AP report and the memo header seen in a search result. The release says the change is effective immediately and does not mention existing tenured faculty; that point rests on AP. The 2026-09-29 academies memo was not opened. The Secretary of Defense memo PDF of 2025-01-29 could not be opened, so its contents come from Higher Ed Dive reporting; the Higher Ed Dive date is inferred from the memo date. The White House page does not show an order number (it is EO 14185 per the Federal Register), whose text does not mention critical race theory. No published findings were found from the academy curriculum reviews, no task force reports and no NDAA language codifying the DEI bans; absence is not confirmed. The 2025 library removals are as reported by AP, and whether books were later returned was not checked. Refutation check 2026-10-28: a Daily Beast report of 2025-10-22 describes a judge temporarily blocking removal of diversity-related books from military school libraries; the report names Judge Patricia Giles but not the court or case, and whether it concerns the Naval Academy library or Defense Department schools was not established; the outlet is not a sufficient source and the report is an unverified lead. A search for NDAA codification of DEI bans returned only advocacy-group statements (naacpldf.org, advancingjustice-aajc.org), used as unverified leads that the FY2026 NDAA contains anti-DEI provisions; the enacted text was not read.
